title: The renewal letter

hook.main: Your renewal letter is not a quote. It's an opening offer.
alts: The rate on page one is the bank's best guess at what you'll accept.
Signing the renewal letter is the most expensive thing you'll do this year.

angle: Reframe the renewal letter as a negotiation document, then show the three questions to ask before signing.
styleWhy: The letter is the hero object; paper-trail stages documents as physical evidence.

beats.text: What would a new lender offer?
Send me the letter before you sign.

cta: Send me your renewal letter before you sign it.
novelty: No past piece for this client used a document as the hero object.

title: 2021 vs 2026

hook.main: Same house. Same balance. $612 more a month.
alts: The rate you locked in 2021 is about to expire.
Five years ago this payment was normal.

angle: Side-by-side of a 2021 five-year fixed and the same balance renewing now; illustrative numbers with working shown.
styleWhy: Broadsheet carries tables and numbers; strongest legibility for a comparison.
structure: number → comparison table → why → 2 options → CTA
cta: DM 'RENEWAL' and I'll run your numbers.
novelty: Broadsheet used 3 times in the last 30 days for this client: flagged as repetitive.

title: The 120-day window

hook.main: You can lock a renewal rate 120 days early. Most people wait for the letter.
alts: Day 120 is the day that matters, not the renewal date.
Your renewal starts four months before the letter arrives.

angle: A countdown calendar: what to do at 120, 90, 30 and 0 days before renewal.
styleWhy: Bento grids hold a timeline of small, equal steps.
novelty: Timeline device not used for this client before; 'tip-120-days' exists as a generic piece (different structure).
